method: The S17 runtime estimate scales measured S13/S15 wall clocks (Kaggle T4 × 2) by each arm's per-step cost relative to v5 at k = 32. GPU and CPU differ in absolute speed, not much in the ratio between two configurations of the same network: this measures that ratio — one training step (forward + backward, batch 32, 64 × 64 patches, a random cube and mask) of each built model, median of 4 after 2 warm-up steps, 8 threads.
